en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1392 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"When you hear the crowing of the rooster, say:
'Glorified and Holy is the Lord (azj) of the angels and the spirit; Your mercy has preceded Your wrath; there is no god but You; glory and praise be to You. I have acted badly and
Indeed, no one forgives sins except You.'".
